verbs.name: title.add
verbs.description: Add a native MOTION-GRAPHICS title: ANIMATED text rendered by resvg per-frame (distinct from captions.add_text's STATIC cards, and built in-house — no external tool). Builds a TitleSpec from a PRESET (lower_third = text near the bottom on an optional translucent bar, fade + slide-up in/out; title_card = large centred text, fade + scale in/out for intros/outros), renders it to a TRANSPARENT overlay video, and composites it on a dedicated TOP-MOST 'title1' overlay video track over [range_ms[0], range_ms[1]). Lowers to honest import + insert ops (the generated .mov lives in the project's titles/ dir; replay re-reads it like any imported media). Geometry/fps come from the project; font_px defaults to a preset-appropriate size from the project height; color defaults to white; bg (the lower_third/top_bar bar) defaults on for lower_third. PRESETS: lower_third | title_card | top_bar (top chyron) | subtitle (small centred bottom line) | headline (bold upper-third banner) — or free placement via x+y. ANIMATION override (fade|slide_up|slide_down|slide_left|slide_right|pop|none) restyles the motion across any preset, so the look count = presets × animations. Use captions.kinetic for per-word text synchronized to a transcript.

range_ms.description: [start_ms, end_ms) on the timeline (absolute); the title animates over this span

preset.description: Title style/position (default lower_third). lower_third = bottom-left on an optional bar; title_card = large centred intro/outro; top_bar = top-left chyron/source label; subtitle = small centred line near the bottom; headline = large bold upper-third banner. (Or use free placement with x+y.)

font_px.description: Font size in px at the project height (default: preset-appropriate)

bg.description: Draw the translucent background bar (lower_third / free placement); default on for lower_third, off for free placement

x.description: FREE PLACEMENT: normalized horizontal anchor [0,1] (0=left, 0.5=centre, 1=right). When BOTH x and y are given the title is placed there, overriding the preset position — the 'drop the title anywhere' path.

y.description: FREE PLACEMENT: normalized vertical anchor [0,1] (0=top, 0.5=middle, 1=bottom). Used with x.

align.description: FREE PLACEMENT text alignment at (x,y); default center

animation.description: Entry/exit ANIMATION override — applies to ANY preset (and free placement), so the option count = presets × animations. fade = pure crossfade; slide_* = fade + glide in from that direction; pop = fade + scale up; none = static, no fade (stays fully on for its whole range). Omit to keep the preset's tasteful default motion (lower_third slides up, title_card scales). IGNORED when `template` is set (templates own their motion).

template.description: Animated-text TEMPLATE — a keyframed, multi-look motion (distinct from the static preset positions). Takes PRECEDENCE over preset + free placement (x/y) and OWNS the motion, so `animation` is ignored. typewriter = characters reveal left-to-right then fade; word_pop = each word pops in centered, one at a time; slide_stack = words stack on rows sliding in from the left; kinetic_emphasis = the phrase appears and one word (see `emphasis`) scale-pops + recolors to `accent`; lower_third_reveal = a bar slides in then a primary (and optional secondary, split the text on '|') line reveals; caption_karaoke = a dim full line with an `accent` highlight that fills word-by-word. List them with the `title.templates` verb.

accent.description: Accent color #RRGGBB for templates that highlight a word (kinetic_emphasis, caption_karaoke). Default a warm gold (#FFD24A).

emphasis.description: kinetic_emphasis only: the word to emphasize (case-insensitive substring match). Omit to emphasize the longest word.

group_id.description: Internal composite-action identity. Consecutive generated/native-lowering edits with the same value undo as one user action.

verbs.result: {title_track, asset_id, clip_id, preset, template, range_ms}; lowers to import + insert ops

verbs.name: title.update
verbs.description: Edit a PLACED title clip's TEXT (and/or style) IN PLACE — the edit companion to title.add (which only ADDS). Selecting a title clip used to give a generic 'Video clip' inspector with no way to change its words. This recovers the originating title.add spec from the op-log, merges the provided overrides (text is the common case; any title.add styling field — color/preset/font_px/bg/x/y/align/animation/template/accent/emphasis — may also be overridden), RE-RENDERS a fresh transparent overlay .mov at the SAME duration, and swaps the clip onto the new asset. The clip id, timeline range, track, and position are all kept; only its pixels change. Commits as ONE lowered op (the asset swap; the new .mov's media.import rides ahead of it) so undo reverts the whole edit and replay re-imports + re-swaps. The clip must be a title overlay clip (on a 'title*' track). Titles generated from captions (captions.kinetic) are NOT editable here — their text is the transcript; edit the captions/transcript instead.

clip.description: Title clip id (a clip on a 'title*' overlay track, from project.state)

text.description: New title text (the common edit; replaces the existing words)

font_px.description: Override the font size in px at the project height

bg.description: Override the translucent background bar on/off

x.description: Override FREE PLACEMENT normalized horizontal anchor [0,1] (used with y)

y.description: Override FREE PLACEMENT normalized vertical anchor [0,1] (used with x)

align.description: Override FREE PLACEMENT text alignment at (x,y)

animation.description: Override the entry/exit ANIMATION (ignored when template is set)

template.description: Override the animated-text TEMPLATE (see title.add / title.templates)

accent.description: Override the accent color #RRGGBB for templates that highlight a word

group_id.description: Internal composite-action identity used by native Motion reimports so all changed objects undo as one user action.

verbs.result: {clip, track, asset_id, text}; one lowered op appended (re-renders the overlay + swaps the clip's asset in place)

verbs.name: title.templates
verbs.description: List the animated-text TEMPLATE catalog that `title.add {template}` accepts — each entry is {name, description, params}. A pure READ (no project needed) so a UI or agent can discover the looks (typewriter, word_pop, slide_stack, kinetic_emphasis, lower_third_reveal, caption_karaoke) and their parameters before placing a title. Generated from the in-house catalog, so it never drifts from what title.add accepts.
